ei.title: Cold Air and Our Weakened Nasal Defenses

fullPassage: Although the idea that working in the cold would lead to catching a cold makes intuitive sense, scientists have only just discovered why. Until recently, the general increase in respiratory illness in the winter was blamed on the fact that people spend more time indoors together, exchanging viruses, in cooler weather. That's likely a factor, but cold is also directly, not just indirectly, responsible for making us sick, thanks to a previously unknown immune mechanism: cells in our nostrils that are capable of detecting incoming microbes and releasing a swarm of tiny little antiviral bubbles to surround and neutralize them. According to the research team behind the breakthrough, at forty degrees, nostril cells release significantly fewer and less powerful defensive bubbles than they do at seventy-five degrees, making it easier for viruses to stage a successful infection.

questions.passage: Although the idea that working in the cold would lead to catching a cold makes (A)[counterintuitive / intuitive] sense, scientists have only just discovered why. Until recently, the general increase in respiratory illness in the winter was blamed on the fact that people spend more time indoors together, exchanging viruses, in cooler weather. That's likely a factor, but cold is also directly, not just indirectly, (B)[irrelevant / responsible] for making us sick, thanks to a previously unknown (C)[digestive / immune] mechanism: cells in our nostrils that are capable of detecting incoming microbes and releasing a swarm of tiny little antiviral bubbles to surround and neutralize them. According to the research team behind the breakthrough, at forty degrees, nostril cells release significantly fewer and less powerful defensive bubbles than they do at seventy-five degrees, making it easier for viruses to stage a successful infection.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① intuitive — responsible — immune: '직관적' 타당성, 추위가 질병에 '책임', '면역' 메커니즘.
❌ ② counterintuitive — responsible — immune: (A) 추위→감기 생각은 '직관적'.
❌ ③ intuitive — irrelevant — immune: (B) 추위가 질병에 '무관'하다는 것은 반대.
❌ ④ intuitive — responsible — digestive: (C) '소화' 메커니즘이 아닌 '면역' 메커니즘.

That's likely a factor, but cold is also directly, not just indirectly, responsible for making us sick, thanks to a previously unknown immune mechanism: cells in our nostrils that are capable of (B)[ignoring / detecting] incoming microbes and releasing a swarm of tiny little antiviral bubbles to (C)[scatter / surround] and neutralize them. According to the research team behind the breakthrough, at forty degrees, nostril cells release significantly fewer and less powerful defensive bubbles than they do at seventy-five degrees, making it easier for viruses to stage a successful infection.

det.analysis:
✅ ② blamed — detecting — surround: 호흡기 질환이 실내 모임 '탓으로 돌려졌고', 코 세포가 미생물을 '감지'하여 '둘러싸' 무력화.
❌ ① credited — detecting — surround: (A) 부정적 원인에는 blame.
❌ ③ blamed — ignoring — surround: (B) 미생물을 '무시' 아닌 '감지'.
❌ ④ blamed — detecting — scatter: (C) 거품을 '흩뿌리는' 것이 아닌 '둘러싸는' 것.

✅ ③ neutralize — significantly — defensive: 미생물 '무력화', '현저히' 적은 '방어' 거품.
❌ ① activate — significantly — defensive: (A) '활성화'가 아닌 '무력화'.
❌ ② neutralize — slightly — defensive: (B) significantly(현저히)이 원문.
❌ ④ neutralize — significantly — offensive: (C) 항바이러스 거품은 '방어적'.
